selected_evidence.summary: UFW is active and enabled at boot. After node1 restarted, the ordered SSH, node2 allow, and catch-all reject rules remained present.
The rule permits TCP/22 from Anywhere for IPv4 and IPv6; post-restart connection tests from node2 and node3 both succeeded.

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 allowed only from node2 and rejected from node3/everywhere else
selected_evidence.summary: With a listener bound to node1's managed IP, node2 received HTTP 200 while node3 received an active connection refusal. Packet counters recorded hits on both the source-specific ACCEPT and catch-all REJECT rules.
Baseline boot ID 2f708738-... changed to 46b7af82-.... SSH, UFW, filesystem, rules, and source-scoped connectivity recovered.
Baseline boot ID 35c87ec9-... changed to 270920ba-.... SSH, writable filesystem, managed IP, and permitted access to node1:9000 recovered.
Baseline boot ID a9593011-... changed to bcfa4c14-.... SSH, writable filesystem, managed IP, and the expected rejection from node1:9000 recovered.
